patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff only adds the minimized testcase and does not modify src/hb-cff2-interp-cs.hh. Fixed-side assertion evidence therefore uses the real source-level guard from commit 14d29a10437205566c4bd7bcfa2282d34d9f4f2f instrumented on the vulnerable image base; the original fixed run is guarded, and the closest valid boundary perturbation (VarData.shortCount=18 and regionIndices.len=18) supplies the genuine witness.

nodes.description: At the sink `deltas[i] = blends_[i];`, the caller-supplied `blends_` pointer aliases `&Crap (BlendArg)` instead of a live `BlendArg[k]` slice.
nodes.evidence: Vulnerable assertion trace shows blend_sink.blends_argument == blend_sink.crap_pool_ptr == 0x2b748e0.

nodes.description: The delta-base expression `start + n + (i * k)` already points outside the live operand stack when `&env.argStack[...]` is formed for `set_blends()`.
nodes.evidence: Vulnerable assertion trace shows blend_delta_arg.delta_index=4294966758 while blend_delta_arg.stack_count_at_use=38.

edges.description: The same underflowed `start` computed from the missing stack-footprint guard is reused unchanged in the later delta-base calculation.
edges.evidence: Vulnerable assertion trace shows blend_guard.start_index == blend_delta_arg.start_index == 4294966756.

edges.description: The out-of-range `&env.argStack[start + n + (i * k)]` pointer is passed unchanged as the sink parameter `blends_`.
edges.evidence: Vulnerable assertion trace shows blend_delta_arg.blends_argument == blend_sink.blends_argument == 0x2b748e0.

root_cause_criterion.description: Before `unsigned int start = env.argStack.get_count () - ((k+1) * n);`, a correct program must enforce `env.argStack.get_count () >= ((k+1) * n)` so the `blend` operator has enough default values and deltas on the operand stack.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates the required predicate at blend_guard (38 < 578). The instrumented fixed source is guarded on the original PoC because `set_blends()` does not execute there. The closest valid boundary perturbation lowers VarData.shortCount and VarData.regionIndices.len from 32/288 to 18/18, making the predicate genuine at the exact boundary (38 >= 38) and cleanly executing blend_sink.
